subject.why: Station wagon clearly matches the brief with cream and red tones, wood panelling, and a roof basket.

category.why: Heroic low angle with a clean road strip at the bottom and stylized clouds in a blue sky gradient.

clean.why: Free of text, logos, UI, borders, and characters.

framing.why: Well-centered composition with ample margins on top and sides.

colour.why: Warm, juicy vehicle colors contrasting cleanly against the saturated sky.

detail.why: Appropriately stylized forms without excessive micro-textures or extraneous props.

style.why: Rendered with smooth, chunky geometry, soft highlights, and a clean satin sheen matching references.
